name: SC-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Sheri Biggs running with large fundraising edge
Minimal Democratic resources and no outside spending
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~95%
model.rationale: The R+21 district lean, Biggs's incumbency, and her roughly twelve-to-one fundraising advantage over Eunice Lehmacher leave no evidence pointing toward an upset, and markets price a Republican win near certainty. The forecast stays anchored to fundamentals with only a slight adjustment for the favorable recent environment.
model.watch: Any unexpected polling, outside spending, or candidate-level development in this low-attention race would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
South Carolina's 3rd District is a deeply Republican seat, and first-term incumbent Sheri Biggs is running for reelection with a decisive financial edge. She has raised over half a million dollars and holds a large cash advantage, while Democrat Eunice Lehmacher has raised only about forty thousand dollars, with no outside spending on either side and a Libertarian also on the ballot.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so expectations rest on the district's strong Republican lean and the resource gap. Prediction markets give the Democrat only a small chance of winning. The forecast calls this race safely Republican, with the main uncertainty being how low turnout in a non-competitive environment might affect the final margin.
